summary: Node/PostgreSQL admission, opaque relay, outbox handoff and BullMQ checkpoint workers; injected generation execution adapter.

key_files.src/app.ts: Bearer-token admission plus optional Better Auth browser sessions, owned Project listing and session-only token management. Public auth-method discovery lets the shared Web hide unavailable login methods; session writes enforce the configured public origin.
key_files.src/postgres.ts: pg pool lifecycle and pinned transaction adapter. Rollback on failure, release in finally, destroy on rollback failure.
key_files.src/migrations.ts: Explicit versioned migration runner; transaction advisory lock and checksum guard. App startup never auto-migrates.
key_files.src/server.ts: HTTP listener and bounded graceful shutdown. Requires DATABASE_URL and CLOUD_PUBLIC_URL; HOST defaults to loopback.
key_files.src/app.test.ts: Real HTTP listener with PGlite SQL, database token lookup, forged identity rejection, owner isolation and token revocation. Not a network PostgreSQL test.
key_files.src/replica-log.ts: Project-scoped opaque binary log + atomic outbox, content-checked idempotent append, lease claims with SKIP LOCKED and fenced acknowledgement. Caller owns authorization; clients/checkpoint worker own Loro validation. pg_notify carries only project/cursor.
key_files.src/outbox-worker.ts: Notification delivery and fenced checkpoint handoff to BullMQ; starts snapshot consumers. No generation product ports configured by this CLI.
key_files.src/checkpoint.ts: Paged immutable-prefix reconstruction using shared LoroStateAdapter, pending-dependency check and monotonic binary checkpoint publication; never truncate event history here.
key_files.src/pg-notifications.ts: One dedicated PG LISTEN connection per process, reconnect plus durable reconciliation; notifications are wake-ups only.
key_files.scripts/test-cluster.ts: Opt-in native Node runner for disposable loopback PostgreSQL plus independent gateway/worker processes; test:cluster. Never deploys or registers a service.
key_files.src/integration/cluster.integration.test: Real TCP PG fault and load acceptance; unique database and child-process cleanup. Separate Vitest config; not default unit suite.
key_files.src/relay-http.ts: Authenticated @loro-dev/streams-client profile: append/catch-up JSON records, binary snapshots and live SSE data. No Loro state; ACK means durable bytes. Not a complete stream provisioning or producer-epoch API.
key_files.src/relay-store.ts: PG snapshot and captured-prefix paged log adapter; retained event IDs provide append idempotency.
key_files.src/checkpoint-store.ts: Database-only checkpoint load/save, separate from Loro worker computation.
key_files.src/relay-http.test.ts: SDK, snapshot/tail, local persistence failure, opaque bytes and Local Host discovery integration.
key_files.src/checkpoint-outbox.test.ts: Delayed coalescing, concurrent tail preservation, lease fencing, failure retention and atomic append/intent rollback.
key_files.src/task-runtime.ts: BullMQ PostgreSQL Flow driver for injected shared generation coordinator, plus durable checkpoint jobs. Stable dispatch IDs; bounded retries; retained jobs; worker-thread computation.
key_files.src/durable-run-journal.ts: PostgreSQL journal using shared frozen-record validation and CAS; initial run and dispatch intent commit atomically.
key_files.src/checkpoint-thread.ts: Isolated Loro checkpoint computation with its own PG connection; leaves queue heartbeat responsive.
key_files.src/durable-run.test.ts: Real PGlite transaction rollback, idempotency, frozen input and stale CAS verification.
Real PG multi-worker Flow, duplicate dispatch, delayed polling, failure projection, transient snapshot failure and SIGKILL generation recovery.
key_files.src/integration/generation-worker-proces: Test-only child process with durable fixture effects; supports killing after staging side effect.
key_files.src/auth.ts: Better Auth PostgreSQL email/password/session and database rate limiting; explicitly migrated auth tables; public origin is the only trusted origin.
key_files.src/generation.ts: Node binding of shared hosted generation admission and lifecycle to PG journal plus atomic dispatch intent. Product provider/storage/publication ports remain injected.
key_files.src/integration/auth.integration.test.ts: Actual HTTP server and real PG: signup/signin, hashed token issuance, cross-origin and cross-account rejection, revocation, signout, and token-backed admission.
key_files.src/personal-assets.ts: Authenticated personal Asset library: shared Resource/GlobalAssetEntry/ResolvedAsset schemas, PG ownership and transactional lifecycle CAS, immutable filesystem media with Range delivery. CLOUD_ASSET_DIR requires a persistent shared volume for multiple API instances.
key_files.src/personal-assets.test.ts: PGlite HTTP contract coverage for user isolation, import idempotency, invalid uploads, ranges, deletion/restore retries and lost media.
key_files.src/integration/personal-assets.integrat: Real PostgreSQL and HTTP: cookie/origin enforcement, upload and read across Node restart, concurrent deletion CAS.
key_files.src/projects.ts: Owner-scoped browser Project management. Creation uses the existing admission store; detail selects Streams sync.
key_files.src/project-document.ts: Transactional owner-scoped Project Loro reads and mutations: locked relay head, checkpoint and contiguous log hydration, atomic relay/outbox append.
key_files.src/project-document.test.ts: PGlite behavior coverage for owner isolation, browser update hydration, persisted mutation and rollback.
key_files.src/timeline-host.ts: Authenticated Timeline Host commands over the durable Project log: list/create/apply/attach/detach/delete, account/project-scoped read receipts and serialized CAS. Rendering and other command families remain separate outstanding adapters.
key_files.src/timeline-definition.ts: Loads the bundled Remotion Timeline projection contract using the same schema hash as the local plugin host; does not claim an executable render runtime.
key_files.src/project-assets.ts: Project Asset SDK HTTP adapter: Loro-backed list/batch/read/references/import, signed account/project observations, and authenticated media ranges. Resource admission commits with Project log updates.
key_files.src/media-store.ts: Shared personal/project immutable media publication, MIME validation and byte-range delivery; content-addressed files require a persistent shared volume.
key_files.src/integration/project-assets.integrati: Real PostgreSQL contract coverage for Project upload retries, immutable identity conflicts, Loro persistence, SDK read receipts, byte ranges and owner isolation.
